name: inspira-timeline
title: Animated Scroll Timeline
blurb: Vertical timeline with scroll-triggered progress line filling from top to…
description: Timeline component displaying a list of events vertically. Each event has a label (e.g., year) and content area. A vertical line on the left animates upward as the user scrolls, driven by Framer Motion's useScroll. Sticky labels align on…
use_when: Company history, product roadmaps, or event chronologies where scroll reveals progression.
avoid_when: Many timeline items (50+) — rendering performance and scroll tracking can suffer.
a11y: Semantic h2/h3 headings. Timeline line is decorative. No keyboard interaction — content must be scrollable.
